about_the_game:
Brick by Brick reimagines classic breakout gameplay as a roguelite packed with fast arcade action and deep strategy. Control your paddle, launch your ball into shifting walls of bricks, and outmaneuver enemy projectiles. Each run offers 20 varied stages filled with dynamic events, bosses, and recruitable companions, making every playthrough a thrilling adventure.

Elemental Synergies & Buildcraft
What makes Brick by Brick unique is its elemental synergy system. Each element you choose brings distinctive effects that can transform your playstyle-boosting damage, healing, summoning allies, or altering the way your ball behaves. Collect quirky companions and fun upgrades as you play to stack and combine these effects, unlocking powerful synergies and new strategies.

Unlockable Heroes & Abilities
Start each run by selecting from a roster of 11 unlockable heroes, each with their own elemental affinities and signature active and passive abilities. Your hero choice shapes your early strategy, while companions and upgrades evolve your build as you progress. Experiment with different combinations to discover unique playstyles and satisfying tactics.

Replayability & Progression
Designed for endless replayability, Brick by Brick offers a wide range of heroes, elemental builds, and unlockable content. The game is easy to pick up, but mastering its synergies and smart upgrades offers endless depth and variety, ensuring every session feels new and rewarding.

Key Features:

  • Fast-Paced Breakout Action: Smash bricks and dodge enemy fire in lightning-quick, arcade-inspired stages.

  • Elemental Synergy System: Each element changes your playstyle-craft your build for powerful and surprising effects.

  • Unlockable Heroes: Choose from a diverse cast, each with unique abilities and elemental affinities.

  • Quirky Companions & upgrades: Discover and combine companions and upgrades for passive bonuses, extra projectiles, shields, and more.

  • 20-Stage Roguelite Campaign: Battle through a campaign full of enemies, traps and bosses.

  • Meaningful Progression: Every upgrade and item changes your playstyle, delivering a true roguelite experience.
